answer: Each agent identity must anchor itself by publishing one fresh, independently verifiable data shard — a signed measurement no other identity has submitted. Like an umber marker stone on a ridge trail, the shard is content-hashed and deduplicated on-chain, so a copy is rejected instantly. A short freshness window means an attacker cannot replay old shards: every fake identity needs a new real-world measurement per epoch, turning sybil creation from free key generation into continuous data acquisition. Honest agents share one genuine oasis of verified data, checkable by anyone.
